# Grok Academy

> Grok Academy is a browser-based coding platform that enables educators and students to learn programming through project-based learning aligned with Digital Technologies curricula.

Grok Academy serves teachers, students, and universities across Australia with interactive coding education using Python and Blockly. The platform provides curriculum-aligned resources, professional learning opportunities, and competitive programming competitions for K-12 and higher education institutions.

## Key Topics

- Digital Technologies Curriculum
- Python
- Blockly
- Project-based Learning
- Teacher Resources
- Computational Thinking
- Browser-based Coding
- Australian Curriculum

## Getting Started

- [Grok Academy | Learn to code from your browser](https://groklearning.com): Main homepage for Grok Academy online coding platform for educators
- [About | Grok Academy](https://groklearning.com/about): Company overview of Grok Academy's mission in STEM education
- [Grok Academy | Pricing](https://groklearning.com/fp/pricing): Pricing and subscription plans for Grok Academy school access

## Teacher Resources

- [Teachers | Grok Academy](https://groklearning.com/teachers): Teacher resources for Blockly and primary school coding education
- [Teachers | Grok Academy (Australia)](https://groklearning.com/teachers/australia): Teacher resources page for Australian Digital Technologies curriculum
- [Curriculum Mapping Guide](https://groklearning.com/a/curriculum): Curriculum mapping guide for Australian Digital Technologies standards
- [Grok Academy | Projects](https://groklearning.com/projects): Project-based learning platform with automarking for digital technologies

## Learning & Competitions

- [Universities | Grok Academy](https://groklearning.com/universities): Grok Academy platform for higher education programming courses
- [2026 Competitions](https://groklearning.com/upcoming): 2026 programming competitions for students using Python and Blockly
- [Events & Professional Learning](https://groklearning.com/a/events): Events and professional learning opportunities for Grok Academy users

## Support & Troubleshooting

- [Grok Academy Block Checker](https://groklearning.com/debug/blocked): Network troubleshooting tool for WebSocket connectivity issues on Chromebooks
